literal_2D_equation.definitions: r_ji=x_j-x_i; ghat_ij=C_i*grad_i(W_ij), using the receiver normalization from Eq22; gp_i=sum_j V_j*(p_j-p_i)*ghat_ij; F_ij=dot(r_ji,ghat_ij)/dot(r_ji,r_ji); D_mn=4*r_m*r_n/r2-delta_mn.
literal_2D_equation.Eq23: H_mn=sum_j V_j*((p_j-p_i)-dot(gp_i,r_ji))*D_mn*F_ij. Retain Hxx,Hxz,Hzz, not trace alone.
literal_2D_equation.matched_trace: 2D trace(D)=2; production d=-r_ji and dp=p_i-p_j. With both pair matrices equal receiver C_i, Eta2=0, matched volumes/neighbors/kernel and unchanged gradient target, lp-gp_i dot lx=trace(H). This algebra is not discrete Eq23 validation or quadratic exactness.
